title: Create your XRP wallet
description: In this quick XRP Mobile walkthrough you'll create a self custody XRP wallet on the XRP Ledger, save your recovery phrase, set a PIN and enter a referral code. XRP Mobile is a noncustodial wallet where you can buy, send, receive and swap XRP. Perfect if you're getting started with XRP or self custody.
lede: Want your XRP in a wallet that is truly yours? Let's set one up in under a minute.

steps.caption: Open XRP Mobile
steps.body: Open XRP Mobile. It's a self custody wallet, so the keys stay on your phone, not with an exchange.

steps.caption: Tap Create wallet
steps.body: Tap Create wallet. You could import one you already have, but today we start fresh.

steps.caption: Reveal and write down your 12 words
steps.body: Tap to reveal your recovery phrase, then write the 12 words down in order and keep them somewhere safe. Anyone who has them can take your funds, and nobody from XRP Mobile will ever ask you for them.

shots.alt: Reveal and write down your 12 words

steps.caption: Name your wallet
steps.body: Give the wallet a name so you can tell it apart later. You can change it whenever you like.

steps.caption: Set a 4 digit PIN, twice
steps.body: Now set a 4 digit PIN and confirm it. You'll use it to unlock the app and to sign every transaction.

steps.caption: Notifications are your call
steps.body: Turn on notifications to stay on top of the latest updates, or skip it and decide later in settings.

steps.caption: Wallet created
steps.body: And that's your XRP Ledger account ready. Tap Open wallet.

steps.caption: Enter your referral code
steps.body: Got a referral code? Type it in here to join the campaign.
